title: The narrated rule refuses merge --confirm piped through any filter before tail or head, not only through tee.
ruling: Coordinator, 05:48 CST Nov 8, extending its 05:15 ruling on PR 1666: the narrated (live-stream) rule refuses merge --confirm piped through a tee into tail or head. At 06:47 CST the coordinator widened it to any filter between the wait and tail or head. The harm is the same: tail cuts the output and the heartbeat is hidden until exit.
quote: The coordinator ruled at 2026-11-08 05:48 CST, extending its 05:15 ruling on #1666: the narrated rule (live-stream) refuses `merge --confirm` piped through a tee into tail or head.
